title: Payroll variables cut-off — Belgium
body: From 1 July 2026, payroll variables (overtime, absences, bonuses) for Belgian clients must be submitted by the 20th of the month to be included in that month's payroll run. Variables received later are processed in the next run. This replaces the previous cut-off on the 22nd.

claims.statement: Payroll variables for Belgian clients must be submitted by the 20th of the month.
claims.quote: must be submitted by the 20th of the month

title: Payroll calendar 2026 — Belgium (FAQ)
body: Q: What is the monthly cut-off for payroll variables? A: The 20th of each month, since July 2026. Late variables move to the next payroll run.

claims.statement: The monthly cut-off for payroll variables is the 20th of each month since July 2026.
claims.quote: The 20th of each month, since July 2026

title: Client onboarding handbook — Belgium
body: Chapter 4 — Monthly cycle. Payroll variables must reach SD Worx by the 22nd of the month. Corrections after payroll closing are handled in the next run.

title: Company car policy 2023 — Belgium
body: Company car policy (2023). Employees in a car-eligible function get a monthly lease budget of €650, including fuel card and insurance. A bigger car is possible with a personal contribution.

claims.statement: The company car lease budget in Belgium is €650 per month.
